parsed.production_notes: The advertisement features human-recorded actors in a live-action talk show setting, combined with a clearly AI-generated CGI robot character for the AI tutor segments.
parsed.interaction_pattern: AI tutor quizzes a human learner who makes spontaneous English mistakes, and the AI provides live correction.
parsed.audio_track: The audio consists entirely of spoken dialogue in Marathi and English between the characters. There is no background music or song.

characters.appearance: A woman in her late 30s or early 40s with a medium build and fair complexion. She has long, dark brown hair styled loosely over her shoulders. Her facial features are defined, with expressive dark eyes.
characters.wardrobe: A traditional beige or light gold Indian saree with a prominent red and gold border. She wears small earrings.
characters.demeanor: Engaged, professional, and curious, with an encouraging smile.

characters.appearance: A man in his late 30s or early 40s with a slim to medium build and a fair complexion. He has short, neatly styled dark hair, a full beard and mustache, and wears modern eyeglasses.
characters.wardrobe: A white collared shirt worn under a dark blue sleeveless vest (Nehru jacket) and matching dark trousers. He wears a watch on his left wrist and brown leather dress shoes.
characters.demeanor: Approachable and friendly. He appears confident as a presenter but portrays a slightly clumsy, good-natured learner during the AI interaction.

characters.appearance: A humanoid robot with a distinctly female form, featuring a glossy white chassis with black and grey mechanical joints visible at the neck. The face is smooth and stylized with large, luminous blue eyes and a subtle, fixed smile.
characters.wardrobe: The character is a robot; its body is its wardrobe, consisting of a sleek white and black robotic frame.
characters.demeanor: Calm, patient, and helpful, with a consistently neutral yet encouraging facial expression.

Character A says: कसं? [How?]

Character B says: With MySivi, of course. बघा कसं. [See how.]

scenes.audio_transcript:

Character B says: My name is Akshay.

Character C says: तुमचं वय काय? [What is your age?]

Character B says: I have 39.

Character C says: तुम्हाला हे म्हणायचं होतं का? I'm 39. [Did you mean to say this? I'm 39.]

Character B says: Oh yeah, right. I'm 39.

Character C says: Where are you from?

Character B says: I am Mumbai.

Character C says: छान प्रयत्न, पण तुला म्हणायला हवं, I am from Mumbai. [Nice try, but you should say, I am from Mumbai.]

Character B says: I'm sorry, I make mistakes.
